title: Microsoft Viva: Insights and Copilot Analytics in GCC and GCC High
description:
We are expanding the availability of Viva Insights and Copilot Analytics capabilities in Microsoft 365 Government Community Cloud (GCC, or GCC-M) and GCC High (GCC-H). Availability differs for a small number of capabilities by cloud, as noted below.

•	Eligible users will see updated Insights app features and supported Insights Admin Center experiences.

•	Adoption and Impact experiences will include supported Copilot usage and impact measures, group and app views, trends, and filters.

•	Analysts will gain access to additional Advanced Analysis reports and queries. Supported users will also have sharing, delegation, and report-publishing capabilities.

Cloud-specific differences

•	GCC only: Adoption by app for Edge and the Microsoft 365 Copilot app.

•	GCC High:  Impact supports scope, organization, and time-period filters, but not license, job-function, or usage-level filters.  Creating an analysis excludes Copilot.
